Alyssa Chen: Quick weekly health snapshot — focusing on 95th/99th latency by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. See dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/cs/1828123456 :eyes:

Alyssa Chen: TL;DR: overall usage +8% WoW, spend +12% (more long-sync requests). Key latency notes below.

Alyssa Chen: DATA SNIPPET (top routes / models):
```
/route        model         mode         p95    p99    errors
/chat         rdx-gpt-4q    streaming    210ms  390ms  0.08%
/generate     rdx-gpt-4q    non-stream   520ms  1.2s   0.4%  <- +40% p95 vs last week
/embed/bulk   rdx-embed-l   non-stream   900ms  2.4s   0.9%  <- timeouts increasing
/rerank       opt-ranker    streaming    170ms  320ms  0.02%
```

Alyssa Chen: Notes: the biggest regression is non-stream /generate on rdx-gpt-4q; streaming routes remain mostly healthy. Also seeing more long-context sync requests (seq_len > 4k) driving spend. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Marco Diaz: I dug into the logs — spike around 03:07 UTC corresponds to a canary rollout to rdx-gpt-4q-v12 (small kernel change). 03:07–03:12 window shows higher tail latency and >50% of affected requests were non-stream sync. :warning:

Marco Diaz: stack snippet from proxy traces:
```
2027-04-15T03:08:12Z proxy: route=/generate model=rdx-gpt-4q-v12 seq_len=4500 latency=980ms status=200
2027-04-15T03:09:04Z proxy: route=/generate model=rdx-gpt-4q-v12 seq_len=6100 latency=1.9s status=200
```

Priya Singh: FYI — NimblePay onboarding ran integration tests overnight and reported slow end-to-end responses for sync generation. They're sensitive to latency for the fraud-check path. Risk: renewal conversation in 6 weeks if friction persists. :eyes:

Priya Singh: Requesting an enablement + technical deep-dive with NimblePay next Tue. Can we reduce their p99 before that?

Kevin O'Neill: Quick mitigation ideas:
- temporary fallback: prefer streaming for requests with seq_len > 2k for /generate routes
- bump KV cache TTL for gpt-4q model shards to avoid cold KV misses
- roll back the v12 kernel change if tail persists after tuning

Kevin O'Neill: config example to flip fallback (low-risk):
```
route "/generate" {
  fallback_mode: "streaming"
  seq_len_threshold: 2000
}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy rdx-gpt-4q-v12 -> 10% started at 2027-04-15T03:05:00Z. Rollback available.

Marco Diaz: I'm running a quick A/B on v12 vs v11 for non-stream with long contexts. If v12 keeps high tails, I'll trigger rollback.

Alyssa Chen: Action items:
- Marco: finish A/B and revert if p99 on v12 > 1.3s for non-stream (ETA 4h)
- Kevin: apply fallback rule for /generate and increase KV TTL (ETA 2h)
- Priya: schedule NimblePay deep-dive, share traces we can show (ETA: EOD today)

Alyssa Chen: I'll update the customer health board and include this as a potential renewal risk. Follow-ups in this thread. :white_check_mark:
